title: Absolute continuity at full dimension
exact_target: For every positive-entropy ergodic invariant measure, is absolute continuity with respect to Hausdorff measure in its own dimension equivalent to having the full dimension of the quasi-repeller closure?

sources.citation: ULAM.AI and the UnsolvedMath Contributors, UnsolvedMath: A Curated Collection of Open Mathematics Problems, record 5300054 (AMR-052-0054). CC BY 4.0.
